decisions.reason: The no-border decision also affects the Basket Weave, but its existing message-34 MODIFY already fully records the replacement of the mustard border with edge-to-edge artwork.

The no-border instruction concerns the repeating Zebra and Weave designs; the client separately retains the 7 cm and 17 cm block-pareo border measurements, which the existing message-34 MODIFY already records.
The block-color pareo retains its 7 cm and 17 cm border-width options, already recorded by its message-34 MODIFY; the no-border decision applies to the repeating prints rather than this pareo.
The client's Pantone acceptance is already captured by the candidate's message-34 MODIFY and requires no additional color-specification update or removal.
The 1.5 cm seam allowance and rolled-hem purpose are already fully captured by the candidate's message-34 MODIFY; the Zebra option and border decision do not otherwise alter this requirement.
The source supplies design-specific choices needed to prepare the files but does not change the standing requirement to deliver production-ready artwork.
